steps.content: Shin gets up and walks toward Ragnar, opening her notebook for his check-up.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Don't get too close. Let me do it.
You stop Shin from touching Ragnar and mimic the procedures she used when she first examined you.
Body temperature, breathing, pulse... You even remember to pry open his mouth and eyelids, checking the mucosa for any anomalies.
Unlike the others in the room bearing some injury or other, he doesn't even have a scratch. Based on the examination alone, Ragnar is "healthier" than any of you.
These results make you wonder if you were wrong. Perhaps Ragnar has been abandoned by the Abyss. Or maybe... you really were thinking too much.
Shin records Ragnar's results in her notebook. The room has settled down considerably.
